最近一年多，她忙着赚钱，学校根本没来，寝室自然也没住了，那两个室友什么情况她也没时间关注。

只记得她上次去寝室收东西的时候，听到安安在和人打电话，说话特别的暧昧，身上穿的戴的，也上了一个档次。

安安瞪着时笙，双手搂着林少的胳膊，无声的宣誓主权。

“不知许大小姐什么时候有空，我请你吃个饭。”

“林少……”安安不可置信的叫了一声，她好不容易才让这个富二代看上自己，结果转眼他就要请许乘月吃饭，“许乘月，林少女朋友是我，见人就勾搭，你是有多不要脸。”

她不敢和林少对上，只好冲时笙吼。

这妹纸脑子有坑！

时笙鉴定完毕，直接收回视线，“等签合同的时候在吃吧！”

林少还没来得及反应自家新上任的女朋友说的话，一辆保时捷就停在了时笙面前，上车，离开，用了不过几秒。

等车子彻底消失在林少视线，他才一把拂开安安，低声呵斥，“你是不是有病？敢那么和她说话？”

刚才若是她一个不高兴，那个项目就完了！

“我说错什么了？”安安没想到林少会突然吼自己，脸色猛的一变，“你是不是看上她了？”

林少冷笑一声，“我倒是想看上她，可人家看不上我。你知道人家是谁吗？云尚集团的千金，如今身价过亿，她要是能看上我，我倒贴都乐意。”

林少不管安安什么反应，径直离开，他可不想因为一个女人，让到手的项目飞了，他家老子得打死他。

安安在这个圈子也混了一段时间，自然听过云尚集团的许大小姐，但是她没想到，那个许大小姐竟然是她的室友。

许大小姐=许乘月？

这怎么可能！

安安在网上搜了许乘月三个字，跳出来的报道许多，但是都没有照片，可是从那些字里行间，能推断出那个许大小姐，就是她认识的许乘月。

想想曾经自己说过的话，她恨不得一头撞死。

人家堂堂的云尚集团千金，会被人包养？明明从许多地方都能看出她不是普通人，可是她为什么就是没发觉呢？

对了……苏衣衣，是她在她耳边不断的暗示，许乘月被人包养。

想到苏衣衣，安安脸上又是一阵铁青。

三年的时间，时笙让自己的身价达到了楚棠身价的十分之一，楚棠这次倒是没在推脱，在许父许母的见证下，给时笙求了婚。

订婚，结婚，一切都很顺利。

两人感情极其稳定，楚棠未曾有除了时笙外的任何女人，不管出席什么场合，都是同进同出，楚棠对时笙的体贴入微的照顾，羡煞旁人。

然而，只有亲近的人才知道，这两人相处的时候，那绝对火药味十足，随时都能打起来似的。

许父许母晚年幸福美满，唯一觉得遗憾的是，没有看到外孙。

时笙在这个位面守着楚棠离世，她才成功离开那个位面，回到系统空间。

恢复了自己年轻貌美的模样，时笙那叫一个开心，在空间中蹦哒了好一阵才安静下来，她盘腿坐在那本半人高的书面前。

【恭喜宿主回来，宿主可有什么感觉？】系统冰冷的声音适时响起。

In the past year or so, she had been busy making money. She didn't come to school at all, and she didn't live in the dormitory anymore. She didn't have time to pay attention to what was going on with her two roommates.

She just remembered that the last time she went to the dormitory to collect her things, she heard An An talking on the phone with someone. She was talking very ambiguously, and the clothes she was wearing were of a higher quality.

An An glared at Shi Sheng, put his arms around Shao Lin's arms, and silently declared his sovereignty.

"I wonder when Miss Xu will be free. I'll treat you to a meal."

"Young Master Lin..." An An screamed in disbelief. She had finally managed to get this rich second generation to like her, but in the blink of an eye he was inviting Xu Chengyue to dinner, "Xu Chengyue, Miss Lin's friend is me, and you hook up with everyone you meet. How shameless are you."

She didn't dare to confront Mr. Lin, so she had no choice but to yell at Shi Sheng.

There's something wrong with this girl's brain!

After Shi Sheng finished the appraisal, he looked away and said, "Let's eat while we wait for the contract to be signed!"

Before Mr. Lin had time to respond to what his new girlfriend said, a Porsche stopped in front of Shi Sheng. He got in the car and left in just a few seconds.

When the car completely disappeared from Young Master Lin's sight, he brushed An An away and scolded in a low voice, "Are you sick? How dare you talk to her like that?"

If she had been unhappy just now, the project would be over!

"What did I say wrong?" An An didn't expect that Mr. Lin would suddenly yell at her, and her face suddenly changed, "Are you attracted to her?"

Mr. Lin sneered, "I would like to fall in love with her, but she doesn't like me. Do you know who she is? The daughter of Yunshang Group is now worth over 100 million yuan. If she can fall in love with me, I will be happy to do so."

Mr. Lin left regardless of An An's reaction. He didn't want to let the project go away because of a woman, and his father would have to beat him to death.

An An has been in this circle for a while and has naturally heard of Miss Xu from Yunshang Group, but she didn't expect that Miss Xu was actually her roommate.

Miss Xu = Xu Chengyue?

How is this possible!

An An searched for the word Xu Chengyue on the Internet, and many reports popped up, but there were no photos. However, from the lines of the words, she could infer that Miss Xu was the Xu Chengyue she knew.

Thinking about what she had said before, she wished she could hit her head to death.

Will the dignified daughter of the Yunshang Group be taken care of?It was obvious from many places that she was not an ordinary person, but why didn't she realize it?

By the way...Su Yiyi was the one who kept hinting in her ears that Xu Chengyue was being kept by someone.

Thinking of Su Yiyi, An An's face turned pale again.

In three years, Shi Sheng's net worth reached one-tenth of Chu Tang's. Chu Tang did not shirk this time and proposed to Shi Sheng in the presence of Xu's father and Xu's mother.

Engagement, marriage, everything went smoothly.

The relationship between the two is extremely stable. Chu Tang has never had any woman except Shi Sheng. No matter what occasion they attend, they always go in and out together. Chu Tang's considerate care of Shi Sheng is enviable to others.

However, only people who are close to them know that when these two people get along, they are absolutely full of gunpowder and can start fighting at any time.

Xu's father and Xu's mother were happy in their later years. The only regret was that they did not see their grandson.

Shi Sheng watched Chu Tang pass away in this plane, and then she successfully left that plane and returned to the system space.

After regaining her young and beautiful appearance, Shi Sheng was so happy that she bounced around in the space for a while before she calmed down. She sat cross-legged in front of the half-person-high book.

[Congratulations to the host for coming back. How does the host feel?】The cold voice of the system sounded at the right time.
